name: Redact personal data before an LLM call

parameters.content:
## Redact personal data before the model

Emails, US phones, SSNs, Luhn-valid card numbers, and IPv4 addresses are replaced with tokens. The original text is not sent to the model and is not returned.

Attach an OpenAI credential on the chat model. If the model output still matches a personal-data pattern, the response is blocked and the model text is discarded.
